tables.title: ADC register map and reset values for each ADC
tables.text_helper: Table 153, "ADC register map and reset values for each ADC", in section 21.8 (ADC register map) on page 667. Register map: offsets, 32-bit field layout and reset values for 38 registers: ADC_ISR, ADC_IER, ADC_CR, ADC_CFGR1, ADC_CFGR2, ADC_SMPR1, ADC_SMPR2, ADC_PCSEL, Reserved, ADC_SQR1, ADC_SQR2, ADC_SQR3 and 26 more.
